content: Baileys v7: creds.me built in configureSuccessfulPairing from pair-success <device> node: me.id = deviceNode.attrs.jid (PN JID with device suffix in practice), me.lid = deviceNode.attrs.lid (separate @lid id). Contact type has id (LID or PN), lid, phoneNumber. jid-utils: isPnUser = endsWith('@s.whatsapp.net'), isLidUser = endsWith('@lid'); jidDecode parses user/agent/device. LID user part is opaque number, not a phone. Own number must be taken via jidDecode(me.id).user only when server is s.whatsapp.net.
